Host the Wisdom Lab on a spare phone.

- **`deploy/android/`**: no-root phone-server kit (Termux + proot Ubuntu) — one-command
  setup, self-healing start script with daily backups and weekly self-maintenance,
  reboot autostart, and an optional permanent family link via an auto-updated Netlify
  redirect. Full guide in `PHONE_SERVER.md`.
- ~3 W power draw: a dedicated, isolated, essentially free server.
